summary: BI-9F7192F9 phase 1 (design docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-26-s5-rehearsal-requester-enrollment-design.md; owner P2 decision 'Raise by one', DI-2229DA83C80C, contraction BI-A21DB89E). Migration 20261126090000_s5_rehearsal_requester_enrollment adds S5RehearsalRequesterEnrollment, the retained record and single durable marker of an owner-enrolled, never-active synthetic S5 rehearsal requester, plus the S5RehearsalRequesterRetirementReason enum. An all-or-none lifecycle CHECK, a BEFORE UPDATE trigger (facts immutable; only active -> retired, once) and a BEFORE DELETE trigger (rows retained) guard it. Back-relations are added on User (one) and Principal (three). No existing table or row changes.
affectedCopies: S5RehearsalRequesterEnrollment rows: inserted only by the owner-operated preview enrollment (later phases of BI-9F7192F9, inert until BI-8EA98961, BI-5C193A3F, BI-60FC9291, BI-588688A7 and BI-C7100183 are served) and moved active -> retired only by owner retirement. Read by isGovernedRequester (apps/web/lib/identity/s5-rehearsal-enrollment.server.ts). Never deleted; linked User and Principal rows cannot be deleted while it exists.
Sanitized clone: the table is sensitivity=restricted, so the clone skips it; the clone destination fence and requester-bearing source refusal land in phase 2 of this item.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: restricted: identity and security-audit evidence references for a synthetic rehearsal account (setup digest and ruling/reservation/attempt/fixture/installation/lease/DB-identity references) plus the enrolling and retiring Principals. No password, hash, token, session or real personal data.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: The subject is a synthetic, owner-held rehearsal account, not a person. The enrolling and retiring Principals are governed on their own records.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Business record retained for the life of the installation's database (retention=domain). Evidence is per-installation and per-database; it does not travel across a clone or reset.

migration.name: 20261126090000_s5_rehearsal_requester_enrollment
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Before any row exists, a manual down drops the table, the enum and the two guard functions (noted in the migration header). Once a row exists it is retained evidence and is not dropped.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Business record, retained: rows cannot be deleted (BEFORE DELETE trigger); facts are immutable and the only transition is active -> retired, written once. Restrict foreign keys keep the linked User and Principals while the record exists.

fields.reason: sha256 of the canonical setup key; an opaque digest, not a reference to a person.
Foreign key to the synthetic requester User; governed by the User asset.
Foreign key to the synthetic requester's human Principal; governed by the Principal asset.
Foreign key to the enrolling owner Principal; governed by the Principal asset.
Foreign key to the retiring owner Principal; governed by the Principal asset.
